headline: Weathered Expanse Burns Hot as Gutter Tempo Eases
war_summary: The morning wire finds Weathered Expanse still hottest at six changes in two hours and twenty-three on the day around Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch, now five Warden to one Colonial with three neutral, while Gutter cools to four in two hours though twenty-seven in six around Kuoppa and Rikki Sarana, now two Warden to four Colonial with one neutral, and Palantine Berm holds at four in two hours and twenty-seven on the day around Windburn Landing and Vendett, now one Warden to six Colonial. Linn Mercy quiets to none in two hours and two in six with fifteen on the day around Outwich Ranch, still two Warden to eight Colonial with one neutral, and Nevish Line likewise stills to none in two hours and three in six with nineteen on the day around Blackcoat Way, now seven Warden to one Colonial. Marban Hollow eases to none in two hours and three in six with twenty-three on the day around Oster Wall. Godcrofts falls silent after forty-six on the day, and Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle again post heavy casualties, eleven thousand and nineteen hundred Colonial in a day respectively, without a single flip.
